title: DAMN
blurb: Drawn out, slightly awed, and delivered on behalf of everybody watching. This is the crowd reaction compressed down into a single voice: something has just happened, it was worse than expected, and somebody needs to formally acknowledge it before the conversation can continue. Play it after a burn lands, a secret drops, or somebody gets comprehensively told in front of witnesses. It carries no judgement about whether the victim deserved it, which is part of the appeal. The correct response to witnessed devastation, and it has been for a very long time.
